question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, S, T, and U are sitting in a row, facing north. No one sits to the right of D. Only three people sit between D and S. Only two people sit between S and T. C sits third to the left of U. A sits to the immediate right of U. How many people sit between B and T?
solution:
Given: Seven people, A, B, C, D, S, T, and U are sitting in a row, facing north. 

1) No one sits to the right of D. 

2) Only three people sit between D and S.
